fusions.name: Drifting Quarrel
fusions.desc: Fires a slow arrow that deals 7 water damage to the first enemy it meets; 20% of the damage comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Tide Wash
fusions.desc: Looses a wide fan of slow arrows 4 tiles ahead that deals 12 water damage to everything in it and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Unhurried Mending
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Placid Constitution
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
